name: Clara Answers – Full Automation Pipeline

nodes.name: Webhook: Demo Call Input
nodes.notes: Trigger for Pipeline A. Accepts: account_id, transcript (text or file path). Method: POST.

nodes.name: LLM Extraction: Account Memo v1
nodes.notes: Calls local Python extraction service. Falls back to rule-based if LLM unavailable.

nodes.name: Create Task Tracker Entry
nodes.notes: Creates Asana task or logs to local task tracker JSON. Swap HTTP node for Asana node when API key is available.

nodes.name: Webhook: Onboarding Input
nodes.notes: Trigger for Pipeline B. Accepts: account_id, transcript. Loads existing v1 memo automatically.

__notes: Import this file into n8n: Settings -> Import workflow. See README for setup. The HTTP nodes pointing to localhost:5001 call the local Python extraction service (scripts/api_server.py).
